question: \(\sqrt{47}-2\) lies between two consecutive integers. What is the smaller integer?
solution: \(36<47<49\), so \(6<\sqrt{47}<7\). Subtracting \(2\) gives \(4<\sqrt{47}-2<5\). The smaller integer is \(4\).
